title: The Ugly Duckling (The Triumph of the Swan)

full_text:
Hunted across moors, pecked by barnyard fowls, and frozen fast in the winter pond, the awkward gray fledgling endured every cruelty with patient fortitude. He never cursed his tormentors, but mourned that he was too strange to be loved.

Yet when the spring sun thawed the waters, he unfolded his mighty wings and soared toward the magnificent white swans on the lake, ready to surrender his life rather than live despised.

Looking down into the crystal water, he beheld not an ugly, clumsy duckling, but a radiant, graceful swan—the king of water-birds! The children cheered, and his companions stroked his neck in welcome, teaching all the world that inner worth will always rise to its rightful heritage.
moral: Suffering and rejection cannot diminish the nobility that waits to unfold within.
